column1: # unit-464reach — the hand read, REVISED after drive1. This file is the verdict; HAND-READ-12.tsv
# is kept unchanged as the record of what was filed BEFORE the instrument existed.
# Stamped: revised at rev 62bcc52e, 13 rows (was 12). [[feedback_rederive_the_hand_map_after_repairing_the_subject]]
# WHAT MOVED, and why. Two changes, both forced by a red in drive1:
# 1. `unit-464vac-2026-10-31/measure.mjs:79` (G0, REFUSE-SITE) was classed **GATE** in
#    unit-464class's census. It is CROSS-STATE. It reads `git rev-parse HIS_REV:p` and
#    `MY_REV:p` for every subject — two states of the subject in one predicate. It was flagged by
#    GWHYPROXY and a hand read of the predicate confirmed the flag. So the census's class counts
#    published in LEG-CLASS-CONVENTION v1.0 are wrong by one: CROSS-STATE 13, GATE 34.
# 2. `unit-464vac-2026-10-31/measure.mjs:80` (G0) was classed CROSS-STATE **keyed** on the
#    strength of a `why` I wrote that says "between his rev and my live tree". The source says
#    `const MY_REV = readFileSync('baseline.rev', 'utf8').trim()` — a recorded rev, not the
#    worktree. NEITHER side is live, so it is **staleness**, not keyed. My own why column was the
#    error. [[feedback_read_a_precedence_claim_off_the_live_array]]
#    This is also where I depart from Theseus's matrix: his keyed-and-reachable 3 counts this row,
#    because for this one row he used my sub-kind rather than measuring it. It is 2.
# The ordered hazard key, revised. Step 1 of the 12-row version ("is NEITHER side live ->
# staleness") was wrong: it swallowed readability preconditions that compare each state to `null`
# and never to each other. The comparison question has to come first.
#   CLASS (what the predicate READS):
#     does it read more than one state of the subject in one predicate?   -> CROSS-STATE
#     else does it read the live subject's defect SPELLING?                -> PIN
#     else                                                                 -> GATE
#   Two frozen revs are two states. The live worktree is not privileged here.
#   HAZARD (what it COMPARES), inside CROSS-STATE, first yes decides:
#     1. are the states never compared TO EACH OTHER (each vs a literal)? -> conjunctive
#     2. does the comparison assert they DIFFER?                          -> delta      (sound)
#     3. is NEITHER side the live worktree?                               -> staleness
#     4. is the compared figure OUT of a cure's reach?                    -> inert
#     5. otherwise                                                        -> keyed      (HAZARD)
